scope: BTCPay NBXplorer consumer gate against an existing native/systemd Bitcoin Core service

btcpay_consumer.full_btcpay_reason: The disposable VM has no initialized LND TLS certificate or macaroon; the gate did not fabricate Lightning credentials.

defects_found_and_fixed: The standard App Store bitcoin.conf now whitelists the fixed private consumer subnet before first start and migrates existing App Store configs idempotently.
BTCPay PostgreSQL repair now retries the temporary pg_isready/shutdown window observed during first initialization.
discarded_fixture_observations: Network-specific regtest bind settings were initially outside the [regtest] section; Bitcoin Core rejected the fixture before opening sockets.
A host-side NBXplorer status request was correctly blocked because NBXplorer was not published; readiness was instead verified from the container's internal state transition.
PostgreSQL briefly accepted pg_isready and then shut down its temporary initialization server; this exposed the product retry gap fixed in this slice.

validation.windows_go_test_all: two pre-existing CRLF-sensitive installer-script failures only
